title: Refactor: Optimize performance, database transactions, remove pandas, and fix reconciliation
body: This PR optimizes database writes by wrapping them in transactions, replaces the heavy pandas dependency in attendance checks with standard libraries, fixes a Kakao Talk membership reconciliation bug where left members were not correctly tracked, and implements various timezone/performance cleanups.
